subject: Add support for autograd parameter filtering (#589)
message:
Add support for autograd parameter filtering (#589)

* Add support for autograd parameter filtering

Integrate functionality to filter parameters based on autograd support in various classes and methods. Introduce new tests to validate the correct behavior of autograd-specific parameter handling, ensuring robustness and expected behavior.

Signed-off-by: ua0295abfcaf0113e <ua0295abfcaf0113e@users.invalid>

* Add Kahan summation for better numerical stability in NLL calculation

Implemented Kahan summation to improve numerical stability during large likelihood calculations. Added a new kahan parameter and updated relevant functions to incorporate Kahan sum logic. Updated tests and changelog to reflect these changes.

Signed-off-by: ua0295abfcaf0113e <ua0295abfcaf0113e@users.invalid>

* Refactor autograd handling and expand tests.

Replaced deprecated function calls with updated ones for autograd computation, improving error handling for unsupported cases. Added comprehensive tests to verify new exceptions and gradient checks for parameters.

Signed-off-by: ua0295abfcaf0113e <ua0295abfcaf0113e@users.invalid>

* Reorganize imports and clarify error message.

Moved imports to comply with the project's import order conventions. Enhanced the `AutogradNotSupported` error message to provide clearer instructions on how to use alternatives to automatic gradients.

Signed-off-by: ua0295abfcaf0113e <ua0295abfcaf0113e@users.invalid>
